description: This file contains unit tests for the ResetConnectionMetricsResponse class, which is part of the connectivity command responses in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies behavior such as equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: ResetConnectionMetricsResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ResetConnectionMetricsResponse, testing equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path retrieval.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ResetConnectionMetricsResponse and its ConnectionId are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that passing null connection ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests conversion from JSON object to ResetConnectionMetricsResponse instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the instance serializes correctly to JSON.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the resource path retrieved matches the expected JSON pointer.
